name: Battle Blizzard
description: A blizzard that periodically intensifies and damages players. It can be activated by a room variable.

fields.name: Extended Duration
fields.description: Extends the time before the blizzard intensifies.

fields.name: Activation Sound
fields.description: Enables a sound effect when the blizzard activates.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: The room variable used to activate or deactivate the blizzard.
